decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established Trivital consumer health line, costs little to keep on pharmacy shelves, and has its own page, so its option value is still open and cheap to hold.
The skin and hair supplement was actively promoted as new in pharmacies, and two years is too early to judge its value given its low carrying cost within the existing supplement brand.
The joint health supplement extends an established brand into a stable demand segment, so keeping it open is inexpensive while its market response is still uncertain.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is more niche and only mentioned on the website, but it is a low-cost option and no negative evidence has yet appeared.

The generic valsartan is distant from the firm's core, sits in a low-margin commodity segment, and was hit by the 2018 NDMA contamination recall, which suggests its value is unlikely to justify the cost of re-sourcing the active ingredient and rebuilding trust.
